Running command: python3 -c "
import tarfile
tar = tarfile.open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/stb/jpg.tar.gz')
count = 0
for member in tar:
    if member.name.endswith('.jpg') and count < 3:
        f = tar.extractfile(member)
        data = f.read()
        print(f'=== {member.name} ({len(data)} bytes) ===')
        # Find all markers
        i = 0
        while i < len(data) - 1:
            if data[i] == 0xff:
                marker = data[i+1]
                if marker == 0xd8:
                    print(f'  SOI at {i}')
                    i += 2
                elif marker == 0xd9:
                    print(f'  EOI at {i}')
                    break
                elif marker in (0xc0, 0xc1, 0xc2):
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'  SOF{marker-0xc0} at {i}, len={length}')
                    print(f'    Size: {(data[i+5]<<8)|data[i+6]}x{(data[i+7]<<8)|data[i+8]}, comps={data[i+9]}')
                    offset = i + 10
                    for c in range(data[i+9]):
                        h = data[offset+1] >> 4
                        v = data[offset+1] & 0x0f
                        print(f'    Comp {c}: id={data[offset]}, h={h}, v={v}, tq={data[offset+2]}')
                        offset += 3
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xda:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'  SOS at {i}, len={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xdb:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'  DQT at {i}, len={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xc4:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'  DHT at {i}, len={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xe0:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'  APP0 at {i}, len={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xfe:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'  COM at {i}, len={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xdd:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'  DRI at {i}, len={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0x00:
                    i += 1
                else:
                    i += 1
            else:
                i += 1
        count += 1
"
